Discover the untold story of the Waldenses—faithful Christians who fled to the mountains and hid in caves to escape persecution from the papal system, the Antichrist power described in Bible prophecy. Learn how their courage, sacrifice, and stand for truth foreshadow what God’s people will face again in the last days. History is repeating—are you ready to stand?
